info.scriptSrcText: property this, thisMemberon beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  thisMember = this.memberNum  this.locZ = 1500endon exitFrame  this.locH = -1000  this.locV = -1000  thisMember = thisMember + 1  if thisMember > 182 then    thisMember = 175  end if  this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")end
info.name: SnowBlow
